# Lemon Studio's plugins Honeydew vendors (README.md beside this file), read by tools/sync-lemon-plugins.sh and the
# lemon-effects workflow. One upstream plugins/<name> per line: its folders are vendored as <name>/ (not examples,
# tests or benches), with every plugin and crates/<name> its manifest depends on, worked out from upstream's
# Cargo.toml files. os-engine is Honeydew's own subset: the lines os-engine/src/<file> are its upstream files the
# plugins use (declare a new one in os-engine/src/lib.rs).
